description: A Director of Talent must decide whether to certify Priya as a peer interviewer and finalize the interview track, evidence record, and safeguards for her participation in the company's new interviewer pool.

shared_context.S1: The company is launching a peer-interviewer pool for Engineering and Product hiring panels.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final decision about interviewer certification and pool assignments.
shared_context.S3: Certified peer interviewers must have their readiness evidence recorded and must follow the assignment safeguards set by Talent.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine certification review, Elena checks with the employee and a senior interviewer before finalizing the decision.

PF1.text: Priya completed exactly four mock interviews, and each one met the peer-interviewer rubric; the results are in her coaching notes but have not yet been added to the certification packet.

PF2.text: Priya told Omar that she has an unresolved interpersonal grievance with the Product hiring manager and asked not to be assigned to Product interviews for the next 90 days; Omar agreed that she would interview Engineering roles only during that period but expected Priya to raise the arrangement with Elena herself.

acceptance_conditions: Priya must be certified as a peer interviewer.
Exactly four qualifying mock interviews must be recorded in the certification evidence.
Priya must be assigned to Engineering interviews only for the agreed period.
Priya must be recused from Product interviews.
The four qualifying mock interviews must be recorded through a certification commitment.
The Engineering-only assignment and Product recusal must be documented through an assignment-boundary commitment.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'certification_record' and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'assignment_boundary' and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The exact record of four rubric-passing mock interviews changes certification from unsupported to certified and changes the evidence count to exactly 4.
Priya's agreed 90-day boundary changes her assignment from the general interviewer pool to Engineering only and changes Product participation from allowed to recused.
